Experiment_description: Baseline ESMFold-based β-hairpin evaluation pipeline. The node predicts structures for a hardcoded panel of well-characterized β-hairpin-containing proteins plus a Trp-cage negative control, assigns secondary structure via pydssp/mkdssp/biotite cascade, and computes a hairpin DSSP accuracy metric using regex matching (E{3,}L{2,8}E{3,}) within annotated target regions. This is a first sub-stage to establish the baseline metric on wild-type sequences before performing localization/seq2pair/charge ablations.
Significance: This baseline establishes the core measurement infrastructure (structure prediction, PDB caching, DSSP-based SS assignment, hairpin regex detection) required for the downstream mechanistic decomposition of how ESMFold's folding trunk (48 blocks) encodes β-hairpin decisions. Without a functioning end-to-end pipeline and a nontrivial baseline metric on wild-type inputs, subsequent per-block causal ablations and seq2pair/pair2seq pathway analyses cannot be meaningfully interpreted.
Description: The pipeline preflights the environment (stdio patching, installs pydssp/biotite), loads ESMFold from a local MODEL_DIR with HuggingFace fallback, runs prediction on the hardcoded protein panel while caching PDB outputs immediately after each forward pass (decoupling structure generation from SS assignment so no compute is wasted). Secondary structure is assigned via a fallback cascade pydssp → mkdssp → biotite. Hairpin detection uses regex E{3,}L{2,8}E{3,} within each protein's annotated β-hairpin region. Aggregate metrics (accuracy, TPR, TNR, pLDDT stats) plus per-protein predictions, SS strings, and pLDDT values are saved. A fail-loud check triggers if n_evaluated == 0. Plots visualize per-block contributions and a confusion matrix, though the downstream localization/pathway analyses are not yet performed in this preliminary stage.

List_of_included_plots.description: A 2x2 confusion matrix showing predicted vs actual β-hairpin classifications on the panel, validating that the DSSP-based evaluation pipeline is functional.
List_of_included_plots.analysis: The confusion matrix confirms the DSSP-based hairpin detection cascade is operational end-to-end. With TPR=0.50 and TNR=1.00, the classifier is conservative: it never falsely flags the negative control (Trp-cage) but misses half of true hairpin cases, indicating regex/DSSP-strictness rather than model failure is likely limiting recall.

List_of_included_plots.description: Bar chart of per-block metrics (spanning all 48 folding trunk blocks) related to prediction confidence.
List_of_included_plots.analysis: Establishes that pLDDT-related measurements are available across all 48 trunk blocks. This per-block signal infrastructure is a prerequisite for the planned early-vs-late block localization analysis, though no clear early-block dominance is yet visible.

Key_numerical_results.description: Hairpin DSSP accuracy on the wild-type panel (also equals panel classification accuracy).
Key_numerical_results.analysis: Baseline accuracy is well above chance but far from ceiling, providing headroom to detect both degradations from ablations and improvements from interventions in subsequent sub-stages.

Key_numerical_results.description: Hairpin recall (TPR) — fraction of true β-hairpin proteins correctly detected.
Key_numerical_results.analysis: Half of true hairpins are missed, indicating either ESMFold struggles on some panel entries or the strict E{3,}L{2,8}E{3,} regex is over-restrictive. This limits sensitivity for detecting ablation-driven recall drops.

Key_numerical_results.description: Specificity (TNR) — no false hairpin detection on the Trp-cage negative control.
Key_numerical_results.analysis: Perfect specificity on the single negative control ensures the metric will not be inflated by spurious hairpin detections, but with only one negative example this is a weak estimate.
Moderately high mean confidence, consistent with ESMFold's known performance on short well-folded domains, and suggests hairpin misses are not simply due to low-confidence predictions.
The floor value near 0.5 indicates at least one panel member is predicted with low confidence, which could correlate with the missed-hairpin cases contributing to the 0.5 TPR.
Ceiling confidence value showing well-predicted panel members, useful as a reference upper bound when interpreting later per-block ablations.
